# Therapeutics Initiative

> > UBC's Therapeutics Initiative provides evidence-based prescribing resources, clinical data analytics, and continuing education to improve medication use and patient outcomes in British Columbia.

The Therapeutics Initiative is a university-based research and education program at the University of British Columbia dedicated to promoting evidence-based prescribing and therapeutic drug use. The organization conducts pharmacoepidemiology research, publishes clinical guidance, and operates data analytics tools for BC healthcare providers.

## Key Topics

- evidence-based medicine
- prescribing data
- drug therapy
- clinical guidelines
- pharmacoepidemiology
- Therapeutics Letter
- Portrait (prescribing analytics)
- medical education
- therapeutics research
- BC prescribing patterns
- medication safety
- continuing education
- Choosing Wisely Canada
- clinical decision support
- healthcare quality improvement

## Core Resources & Tools

- [Therapeutics Initiative](https://www.ti.ubc.ca): Main hub for evidence-based prescribing resources and clinical information
- [Prescribing Portraits](https://www.ti.ubc.ca/portrait): Clinician portal providing BC prescribing data analytics and peer comparison benchmarking
- [Portrait Online Secure Portal](https://secure.ti.ubc.ca): Secure access point for BC clinicians to view personalized prescribing data and analytics

## Research & Evidence

- [Pharmacoepidemiology](https://www.ti.ubc.ca/research-publications/pharmacoepidemiology): Research program investigating glucose-lowering therapy, medication safety, and prescribing patterns

## Education & Professional Development

- [Continuing Education](https://www.ti.ubc.ca/continuing-education): Educational programs including webinars, podcasts, speaker events, and clinical training

## Organization

- [Members](https://www.ti.ubc.ca/about-us/members): Team directory of faculty, staff, and researchers at the Therapeutics Initiative
